projects.name: Ruwais Diyab Unconventional Gas Development (Phase 1)
projects.location: Ruwais Diyab unconventional gas concession, onshore western Abu Dhabi
projects.value_note: $1.704bn (AED6.26bn) including $310m of optional items, per Jereh's 4 Nov 2026 Shenzhen Stock Exchange filing as reported by SaudiGulf Projects; ADNOC has not disclosed a contract value
projects.scope: ADNOC took FID at ADIPEC on 2 November 2026 on its first large-scale unconventional gas development, delivered under a design-build-operate (DBO) model. Phase 1 targets 345 million cubic feet per day of raw gas from 2029 over a 25-year life, with potential to scale to 1 bcf/d. The DBO scope covers wellsite facilities, a central processing facility, gas gathering and product export pipelines, utilities and treatment of raw gas, liquids, produced water and sulphur, with a new pipeline tying the processed gas into the UAE network. Jereh's letter of award covers a 29-month build and 60 months of operation with two optional five-year extensions; formal contracts are due within 90 days.

contractors.name: Jereh Oil & Gas Engineering Corporation – Abu Dhabi (Yantai Jereh)
contractors.role: Design-build-operate contractor, full field development (letter of award, Nov 2026)

projects.why_it_matters: Marks the start of commercial unconventional gas production in the UAE and a new DBO contracting model for ADNOC, with a Chinese contractor taking the whole scope. Domestic unconventional supply frees conventional gas for Ruwais LNG exports and supports gas self-sufficiency; watch for Phase 2 scaling toward 1 bcf/d and for drilling and well-services packages.

projects.location: TA'ZIZ Derivatives Park, Ruwais
projects.value_note: EPC value not disclosed; $460m-plus (Dh1.69bn) six-year project financing closed in November 2026
projects.scope: A 1 mtpa (3,000 t/d) low-carbon ammonia plant on a 10.8 ha site, targeting marine fuel and export ammonia markets with CO2 captured for storage; reported as approaching completion in May 2026. projects.location: Al Ruwais Industrial City, Abu Dhabi
projects.value_note: EPC value not disclosed; project financing of more than $928m (Dh3.41bn), including $225m Islamic tranche, closed November 2026
projects.scope: Common-user liquid chemicals import/export terminal and storage serving the TA'ZIZ Industrial Chemicals Zone, including the methanol and low-carbon ammonia plants, developed as a joint venture with Advario Star Energy. Rotary Engineering's EPC was reported about 70% complete in November 2026, when a long-term non-recourse financing with nine banks was closed with MUFG as financial adviser.
projects.why_it_matters: The export gateway for every TA'ZIZ derivatives plant: methanol and ammonia volumes cannot reach market without it, so its 2027 readiness is on the critical path for the Ruwais chemicals build-out.
